title: InternetDiscoveryRequest
description: The body of the one POST `shutup-and-run internet on --discover URL` sends, usually to the poll URL, when the person at the PC turns internet sharing on. `lend` is what tells it from a poll. The bearer is SHUTUP_AND_RUN_POLL_TOKEN when it is set at the PC, else there is no Authorization header. It is sent once per `internet on`, never on a schedule. A production endpoint should read the keys it knows and ignore the rest.

worker.description: The PC's name (COMPUTERNAME on Windows, the hostname on Linux). A claim, not proof: the bearer token is what identifies the PC.

os.description: windows, linux, or android (a phone, in Termux).

arch.description: CPU architecture of the binary, as Rust names it: x86_64, aarch64.

version.description: Version of the program, such as 0.2.28.

lend.description: Always internet: this PC asks where to lend its internet connection.
